Josh and Monica's Bull Mahi-Mahi Fishing Adventure in San José del Cabo

Fishing Report Nov 18 Written by EXOTIC FISH-CABO

An Action-Packed Morning of Mahi-Mahi Fishing

November 2025 brought an exciting offshore fishing experience for Josh and Monica in the waters surrounding San José del Cabo.

Joining Exotic Fish Cabo for a private fishing adventure, the couple departed from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, looking forward to spending a memorable morning on the Sea of Cortez.

They didn't have to wait long for the excitement to begin.

The mahi-mahi (dorado) were active, turning their fishing trip into a morning filled with action.

One after another, these colorful fish provided exciting moments as they fought against the lines, displaying the brilliant green, blue, and golden colors that make dorado so recognizable.

But the highlight of the morning was still to come.

Josh hooked into an impressive bull mahi-mahi, a mature male dorado known for its distinctive forehead and powerful fighting ability.

The fish put up a memorable battle, testing Josh's determination as he worked to bring it closer to the boat.

With assistance from the crew, Josh successfully landed his impressive catch, making it the standout moment of their fishing adventure.

Throughout the excitement, Monica kept the energy high, cheering on the action and sharing in the celebration.

Between the catches, laughter, and photographs, the couple enjoyed a memorable morning offshore.

Sometimes, the best fishing experiences aren't simply about catching the biggest fish. They're about enjoying the excitement of the ocean, sharing moments together, and creating stories worth remembering.

For Josh and Monica, this November fishing adventure was certainly one of those experiences.

Trip Highlights

  • Date: November 2025

  • Departure: Puerto Los Cabos Marina, San José del Cabo

  • Anglers: Josh and Monica

  • Species caught: Mahi-mahi (dorado)

  • Catch highlight: An impressive bull mahi-mahi landed by Josh

  • Fishing conditions: Active mahi-mahi bite during the morning

  • Experience: Private offshore fishing charter

Mahi-mahi are known for their spectacular colors, energetic fights, and occasional aerial displays.

Their activity around San José del Cabo depends on changing ocean temperatures, currents, baitfish availability, and seasonal conditions.

Every fishing trip is different, and catches are never guaranteed.
